https://www.example-auto-news.com/byd-sa.title: BYD sales climb in 2025
https://www.example-auto-news.com/byd-sa.body:
BYD sold 4.27 million vehicles in 2025, up from 3.02 million in 2024.

Plug-in hybrids made up about half of those sales.

The company expanded its overseas network to 70 countries.

https://energy.example.gov/ev-outlook.title: Global EV outlook
https://energy.example.gov/ev-outlook.body:
Global electric car sales reached 17 million in 2025.

Battery pack prices fell 20 percent year on year.

Lithium iron phosphate cells now account for 45 percent of the market.

https://www.example-auto-news.com/pricin.title: EV pricing war
https://www.example-auto-news.com/pricin.body:
Tesla cut the starting price of the Model 3 to 32,000 dollars in China.

BYD responded with discounts of up to 12 percent on its Seal sedan.

https://www.example-tech.org/battery-che.title: Battery chemistry explained
https://www.example-tech.org/battery-che.body:
LFP batteries trade energy density for lower cost and longer life.

Solid state cells are not expected in mass production before 2028.
